app.name: Tadhkirah
app.tagline: Remember, reflect, return, and improve — one day at a time.

landing.heroTitle: Gently hold yourself to account, and return to Allah every day
landing.heroBody: Tadhkirah is a calm, private space to review your day, keep your prayers and Quran portion, and remember authentic Sunnahs at the right moments — without points, comparisons or blame.
landing.heroNote: No password · No ads · Your data is yours alone
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for a day closer to Allah
landing.feature1Body: Daily questions you choose yourself, with room for gratitude, repentance and tomorrow's intention.
landing.feature2Body: Follow your prayers, adhkar and voluntary worship, with a clear line between obligatory and voluntary.
landing.feature3Body: Record your recitation, memorization and revision by surah and ayah.
landing.feature4Body: Reminders of Sunnahs and times of supplication, each with its source and grading, after scholarly review.
landing.dayBody: Tadhkirah calculates prayer times for your city on your device, and your day starts at Fajr — so Isha and Witr count for their day, even after midnight.
landing.principle1Body: Your reflections are yours alone. We never show them to anyone, sell them, or train any AI on them.
landing.principle2Body: No weak or fabricated hadith. Nothing is published without documented human review.
landing.principle3Body: No points, rankings or blame. We help you keep going and return — not compete.
landing.ctaBody: Two minutes to set up, then one day at a time, in shā' Allāh.
landing.footer: Made with care to help you do good.
landing.mockReflect: A moment to look back on your day
landing.skyHint: Tap a time to see its sky
landing.t1Body: Begin with the intention you wrote last night.
landing.t2Body: Log each prayer at its time with a single tap — no fuss.
landing.t3Body: A gentle nudge for evening adhkar and your Quran portion.
landing.t4Body: Authentic Sunnahs, with their sources, at the right moment.
landing.t5Body: Look back on your day, give thanks, and set tomorrow's intention.

auth.title: Sign in to Tadhkirah
auth.subtitle: No password needed. We'll email you a code and a sign-in link.
auth.resent: A new code is on its way.
auth.checkSpam: Can't find it? Check your spam folder, or tap the link in the email.
auth.privacyNote: We only ask for your email, and never share it.

verify.failed: This link is invalid or has expired.

today.intro: This is your daily page. Soon you'll find your prayers, adhkar and Quran portion here, and a moment to look back on your day.
today.dayBounds: Your day began at Fajr ({time}) in {place}.

onboarding.title: Let's set up your day
onboarding.subtitle: Just two steps so we can calculate prayer times and start your day at Fajr.
onboarding.locationHint: Times are calculated on your device. We store an approximate location (about 1 km) for reminders only.
onboarding.noResults: We couldn't find that city. Try your current location or enter coordinates.
onboarding.locationDenied: We couldn't access your location. Please choose your city from the list.
onboarding.methodHint: We picked the method most used in your country; you can change it. Compare it with your mosque's timetable.
onboarding.highLatHint: For places far from the equator, where twilight lasts long in summer.
